integrity: Finite checks support but do not replace the scheme-theoretic proof. Independent audit has not been performed; historical implicit priority remains possible. Morrison 1980 predates dated arXiv sources, but an original public release day was not verified.
scientific_limitations: Only 3-dimensional representations of r-loop local radical-square-zero algebras. Characteristic unrestricted; reduced components were known. Does not determine nilpotent multiplicities, full local Artin rings, or higher module dimensions.
title: Nilpotent trace directions and the complete nonreduced locus of three-dimensional square-zero representation schemes
